label: Photo unfold (circle -> grid -> bento -> zoom)
description: One photo becomes a library and the library becomes one photo again -- a relay handoff piece (the 'develop.' film, 2.9-6.0 s). Beats, all pure functions of time: at `at` the hero shows as a CIRCLE at the iris geometry (centre 0.5/0.5, diameter 0.30 of the frame -- exactly where the iris component leaves its photo); at `square_at` the circle becomes a rounded square and springs (overshoot ~20%) to the hero tile (side hero_side, default 0.67 = the reference; the relay contract's 0.46 is hero_side:0.46); at `shrink_at` it shrinks to grid-tile size; at `unfold_at` the 3x3 grid unfolds from behind it like a paper map -- the 4 edge neighbours slide out from under the centre, then at `corners_at` the 4 corners slide out of the top/bottom edge tiles (tiles are rounded squares, object-fit cover, grid 0.644 of the frame, gap 0.0097); at `bento_at` the grid reflows (FLIP-style layout morph) into a 4x3 bento with the zoom tile 2x2 at the top-right and the other eight in the free cells with the least travel; at `zoom_at` the built-in cursor clicks the zoom tile and a camera move zooms it to the FULL FRAME, landing exactly at zoom_at + zoom_duration (0.35 s -- put it on the music drop). The last frame is that photo full-frame, object-fit cover, radius 0 -- identical to a plain full-frame image, so the next scene starts on it. The cursor ends at cursor_to and stays (hand it on). Full-frame component. Example: {"images":["/assets/sunset.jpg","/assets/earth.jpg","/assets/cyclist.jpg","/assets/portrait.jpg","/assets/door.jpg","/assets/arch.jpg","/assets/nebula.jpg","/assets/desert.jpg","/assets/crater.jpg"],"hero":4,"zoom_index":5,"at":2.9,"square_at":3.0,"shrink_at":3.45,"unfold_at":3.65,"bento_at":4.9,"zoom_at":5.65,"cursor_from":[0.8,0.79]}.

images.label: 9 photo URLs in row-major grid order (the centre, index 4, is the hero unless `hero` says otherwise); fewer repeat

hero.label: Index (in images) of the hero photo -- the circle it starts as; it sits in the centre cell (default 4)

zoom_index.label: Index (in images) of the tile the cursor clicks and zooms to full frame (default 5, right-middle)

at.label: Start: the hero as the iris circle (s, default 0)

square_at.label: Circle -> rounded square, springing to hero_side (default at + 0.05)

shrink_at.label: The hero shrinks to grid-tile size (default at + 0.45)

unfold_at.label: The 4 edge tiles slide out from under the hero (default at + 0.7)

corners_at.label: The 4 corners slide out of the top/bottom edge tiles (default unfold_at + 0.25)

bento_at.label: The grid reflows into the bento, zoom tile 2x2 top-right (default at + 1.9)

bento_order.label: Optional: the 8 other image indices in the bento's free cells, row-major (default: least travel)

zoom_at.label: The click on the zoom tile; the zoom starts here (default at + 2.7)

zoom_duration.label: Seconds the zoom takes; it lands at zoom_at + this (default 0.35)

x.label: Centre x, fraction of the frame (default 0.5)

y.label: Centre y, fraction of the frame (default 0.5)

iris_size.label: Start circle diameter, fraction of the frame's short side (default 0.30 = the iris)

hero_side.label: Rounded-square side the hero springs to (default 0.67, the reference; contract 0.46)

hero_radius.label: Hero corner radius as a fraction of its side (default 0.08)

grid_size.label: The 3x3 grid's side, fraction of the frame (default 0.644)

gap.label: Gap between tiles, fraction of the frame (default 0.0097)

radius.label: Tile corner radius as a fraction of the grid tile (default 0.085)

cursor_from.label: [x, y] fractions: where the cursor tip is at `at` (default [0.8, 0.79]) -- match the previous component's cursor_to

cursor_to.label: [x, y] fractions: where it clicks (default: on the zoom tile, inside both its grid and bento boxes); it stays there after the zoom

cursor_move_at.label: When the cursor travels from cursor_from to cursor_to (0.4 s; default bento_at - 0.6)

cursor_exit_at.label: Hide the cursor at this time (default: it stays, for the next component to take over)

cursor_size.label: Cursor size, fraction of the short side (default 0.027)
